## How it works

Each badge is a [shields.io endpoint badge](https://shields.io/badges/endpoint-badge):
shields.io reads its text, colors and icon from a JSON file in
[`endpoints/`](endpoints/). Changes to these files reach every README that uses
the badge (shields.io caches them for up to a day).

If you would rather not depend on this repository, use the self-contained URL
of each badge: everything, icon included, is encoded in the URL.

To change a badge, edit `generate_badges.py` and run it (Python 3, standard
library only):

```sh
python generate_badges.py
```
